ChatGPT misses that the y-axis starts at 11,000 instead of 0, so 2022 looks about six times taller than 2025 even though it is only about 30% more fans. Also, each bar is an average of several home games, and bar charts shouldn't be used for averages; dots with the individual games would show the spread.
